official.application_route: Register and submit a single application through the MBZUAI application portal (apply.mbzuai.ac.ae) for the chosen M.Sc. or Ph.D. program.
official.study_mode: Full-time, on campus (Masdar City, Abu Dhabi)
official.citizenship_residency: Open to UAE nationals and international students with no nationality restriction published; the funding table sets different values for UAE nationals (AED 37,500 M.Sc. / 43,500 Ph.D.) and international students (AED 15,500 M.Sc. / 17,500 Ph.D.). UAE nationals and UAE residents must submit additional identity documents.
official.international_eligibility: Yes - MBZUAI states it welcomes students from diverse backgrounds and nationalities, and publishes funding values specifically for international students.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Applicants must hold a STEM-field degree; the funding model applies to the M.Sc. and Ph.D. programs only. The Master in Applied Artificial Intelligence is a fee-based program (AED 5,000 per credit, 34 credit hours, total tuition AED 170,000) and is not eligible for University or faculty-sponsored funding.
official.research_requirement: A research statement is required from Ph.D. applicants and is uploaded as a PDF; M.Sc. applicants complete a research thesis under a supervisory panel of two or more faculty members. Ph.D. Year 1 funding requires a confirmed faculty advisor match by the end of Year 1, and funding then moves to the faculty advisor's funding no later than the start of Year 2.
official.duration: M.Sc.: full-time, on campus, 36 credits (coursework in the first year, thesis research in the second year, plus a master's internship of up to six weeks). Ph.D.: full-time, on campus, 60 credits, with thesis research pursued for a period of three (3) to four (4) years.
official.description: MBZUAI describes its graduate funding as a partnership between the University and faculty advisors: funded M.Sc. and Ph.D. students receive free tuition fees, a monthly stipend, one return airfare each year to their home country, health insurance for the approved funding period, and a University-sponsored UAE residence visa and Emirates ID where eligible. M.Sc. students are fee-paying by default, with funding secured through a faculty advisor-sponsored research or teaching assistantship or an approved government scholarship for UAE nationals, while Ph.D. Year 1 funding is centrally funded by the University and moves to the faculty advisor's funding no later than the start of Year 2.
official.region: United Arab Emirates (Abu Dhabi, Masdar City) - Middle East
official.program_type: University graduate funding model / fully funded scholarship for MBZUAI M.Sc. and Ph.D. programs
official.english_requirement: IELTS Academic 6.5; TOEFL iBT 90; PTE Academic 60; Cambridge C1 Advanced 180; Cambridge C2 Proficiency 200; Duolingo English Test 120 (accepted only when IELTS/TOEFL/PTE/Cambridge access is limited). Exams must be administered at an approved physical test centre - Home Edition exams are not accepted - and results are valid for 2 years from the test date. Full exemption applies for a degree entirely taught and assessed in English at a university in a listed country where English is an official language (including the UK, US, Canada excluding Quebec, Australia, Ireland, New Zealand, Singapore, South Africa and others); conditional exemption can be requested with an official medium-of-instruction letter on university letterhead, provisionally accepted at application and verified later. Applications without English proficiency documentation remain incomplete and do not progress.

applicant_utility.summary: MBZUAI funds admitted M.Sc. and Ph.D. students through a University-plus-advisor model: tuition is waived and you receive a monthly stipend, an annual return airfare, health insurance and visa/Emirates ID sponsorship. The catch for M.Sc. applicants is that funding is not automatic - you are classified as fee-paying unless a faculty advisor sponsors a research or teaching assistantship or, for UAE nationals, an approved government scholarship is in place. Ph.D. applicants are centrally funded in Year 1 only while an advisor match is confirmed, so your research fit with a named supervisor is effectively part of the funding application. Applications for the Fall 2027 intake close 15 December 2026, 5 p.m. GST, and the AED 200 application fee is only charged after the screening exam.
applicant_utility.best_fit: STEM graduates with a strong quantitative record (CGPA 3.0+ for M.Sc., 3.5 bachelor's or 3.0 master's for Ph.D.) who want fully funded AI research training in Abu Dhabi and can name faculty supervisors whose work matches theirs.
application_readiness_checklist: Shortlist two or three MBZUAI faculty whose research matches your statement of purpose, and reference that alignment specifically - Ph.D. funding depends on an advisor match
Book IELTS/TOEFL/PTE early so a physical test-centre score is ready before the 15 December 2026 deadline; the result must be under two years old at submission

Line up referees in advance (two for M.Sc., three for Ph.D., at least one a former course instructor or research advisor) and confirm their email addresses, since portal requests go out automatically at submission
Prepare transcripts in English with the original plus an official translation, and keep an expected-graduation letter ready if you are still completing your degree
Diarise the screening exam window - the invitation arrives within 10 days of submission and the AED 200 fee is payable afterwards, waived at 75%+
Decide your single program choice before applying: only one application per cycle is processed, and MAAI carries no funding
common_rejection_risks: Submitting a second application for a different program in the same cycle - multiple submissions are not processed at all
Leaving the English proficiency component out by the deadline, which makes the application incomplete and blocks it from review
A statement of purpose that is a generic career essay rather than evidence of AI/technical projects, research and stand-out achievements
Nominating referees who never receive or act on the automated request, leaving recommendations missing
For M.Sc. applicants, assuming admission means funding and then discovering you are classified as fee-paying with Fall 2027 cost of attendance still unpublished
Weak supervisor alignment: internal transfers or mismatches stall the Ph.D. advisor match that funding depends on by the end of Year 1
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The funded package covers tuition, a stipend, annual home return airfare, health insurance and visa/Emirates ID; applicants still fund their own relocation to Abu Dhabi, the AED 200 application fee (unless waived or reimbursed on enrollment), English test fees, document attestation/translation and Certificate of Recognition costs, and any living costs beyond the stipend - the published funding table does not state the stipend's period, so treat the exact annual value as unconfirmed.
document_audit: Statement of purpose must be a 500-1000 word PDF and the research statement (Ph.D.) must also be a PDF - wrong formats or missing files stall review
Transcripts not issued in English need both the original and an official English translation
The passport photo must have a white background, and the passport copy must be valid
A degree attestation (UAE) or Certificate of Recognition (outside the UAE) is due within the first semester, so start that process early rather than at enrollment
A conditional English exemption via a medium-of-instruction letter must be on university letterhead and signed by an academic official; it is only provisionally accepted until verified
alerts: Deadlines differ by program: 15 December 2026 for most graduate programs, 22 January 2027 for M.Sc./Ph.D. Computational Biology, and 28 February 2027 for the fee-based Master in Applied AI
One application per intake only - you cannot hedge across programs
Funding for M.Sc. students is not guaranteed even after admission, and the Fall 2027 cost of attendance for unfunded students is not yet published
Funded students must keep an in-person presence on campus throughout the funded period and need approval before any absence
External scholarships or fellowships must be disclosed and normally replace rather than top up the University stipend
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Register on the MBZUAI portal, submit one complete application with documents, sit the online screening exam within the window given, pay AED 200 (or have it waived), attend a technical interview if invited, then receive a decision by 31 March 2027 and accept the offer by 15 April 2027.
